review_candidates.description: Job Description: Senior Manager – DevOps & DevSecOps Engineering Location: Bengaluru Millenia Duration: 12 Months Experience Range: 6 to 15 Years Minimum Qualification: B.Tech / B.E. / MCA Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Manager – DevOps & DevSecOps to define, execute, and scale the DevOps and DevSecOps engineering strategy for CarelonRx engineering teams in India. In this leadership role, you will align engineering standards with enterprise technology and security priorities, drive shift-left security automation, mature enterprise CI/CD capabilities, and foster AI-enabled engineering productivity. You will lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers while collaborating seamlessly with global US stakeholders. Key Responsibilities DevOps & DevSecOps Strategy and Engineering Excellence Define and execute the DevOps/DevSecOps strategy and roadmap for India engineering teams aligned with enterprise priorities. Establish engineering standards for CI/CD, infrastructure as code (IaC), cloud-native development, security automation, and release management. Drive shift-left security adoption, embedding automated checks early in the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Develop reusable DevOps patterns, templates, and platform capabilities to prevent fragmented, one-off solutions. Reduce manual deployment friction and improve deployment consistency, repeatability, and reliability. CI/CD & Platform Engineering Own and mature enterprise CI/CD capabilities using GitHub Actions, Harness, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms. Establish standardized pipelines covering build, test, security scanning, artifact management, deployment, and rollback. Implement policy-as-code and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and cloud-native tooling. Partner with platform engineering teams to deliver self-service developer capabilities and golden paths. Security Integration (DevSecOps) & Compliance Embed automated security controls across the SDLC: SAST, DAST, SCA, container/image scanning, secrets detection, IaC scanning, dependency management, and SBOM generation. Translate cybersecurity policies into automated engineering guardrails. Establish risk-based vulnerability remediation and exception-management workflows. Ensure pipelines and environments comply with healthcare regulatory standards for protected health information (PHI) and audit readiness. Cloud & Infrastructure Automation Drive DevOps practices across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). Promote automated infrastructure provisioning, environment management, and secure cloud configuration patterns. Support containerized and Kubernetes-based platforms, partnering with cloud engineering to maximize resiliency and scalability. Observability & Operational Excellence Establish standards for logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, and alerting. Partner with SRE/operations to improve production reliability and proactively detect performance issues. Track core engineering metrics (DORA metrics, availability, deployment success, security vulnerability coverage). India Team Leadership & Global Collaboration Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of DevOps/DevSecOps engineers and technical leads in India. Function as a unified engineering organization with US stakeholders, ensuring clear governance across time zones. Build India capability toward full engineering and platform ownership, establishing robust support and escalation models. Developer Productivity & AI-Enabled Engineering Identify and eliminate bottlenecks across developer workflows to maximize productivity. Evaluate and scale AI-assisted engineering for code analysis, security remediation, pipeline troubleshooting, and operational insights.
